an4.50:1.1: bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:3.1: bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti, mahiyā bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso . . . dhūmarajo bhikkhave candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso . . .
an4.50:4.1: Rāhu bhikkhave asurindo candimasuriyānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakiliṭṭhā candimasuriyā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:4.2: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro candamasuriyānaṃ . . . na virocanti. 2.
an4.50:5.1: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave cattāro samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:5.3: Santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā suraṃ pivanti merayaṃ pivanti surāmerayapānā apaṭiviratā.
an4.50:5.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakkiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:6.1: Santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā methunaṃ dhammaṃ paṭisevanti methunasmā dhammā apaṭiviratā.
an4.50:6.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso . . . na virocanti.
an4.50:7.1: Santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā jātarūparajataṃ sādiyanti jātarūparajatapaṭiggahaṇā apaṭiviratā.
an4.50:7.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso . . . na virocanti.
an4.50:8.1: Santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā micchājīvena jīvanti micchājīvā apaṭiviratā.
an4.50:8.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ upakkileso yena upakkilesena upakiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti no bhāsanti na virocanti.
an4.50:8.3: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro samaṇabrāhmaṇānam upakkilesā yehi upakkilesehi upakiliṭṭhā eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā na tapanti na bhāsanti na virocanti. 3.
